content:
Humbled and honoured to be felicitated at the 117th Foundation Day of Patna Law College. ⚖️

It was a privilege to serve as a Member of the Organizing Committee and represent the college on this historic occasion. Being able to contribute behind the scenes and help make this memorable celebration a success was an incredibly rewarding experience. 🎓

Grateful for the opportunity, the trust, and the memories created on this special day. 🙏
